records.name: CADRE
records.operational_role: Interoperability instructor and first field commander
records.historical_or_civil_origin: Created after disclosure-era forces discovered that specialists could not share doctrine, ammunition, or assumptions.
records.mechanic_or_present_function: Keep the node alive long enough for the player to learn what every other doctrine costs.
records.political_or_moral_tension: Cadre has no ideology of its own and fears becoming only the sum of other people's wars.

records.name: VANTA
records.operational_role: Director of the Open Archive Combat Index
records.historical_or_civil_origin: Descended from the public FOIA and sensor-provenance movements that survived the Archive Wars.
records.mechanic_or_present_function: Make contradictory records useful without pretending they agree.
records.political_or_moral_tension: She will expose any secret except the one proving how often Humanity edited its own disclosure history.

records.name: KORRIN
records.historical_or_civil_origin: Unified incompatible Earth, lunar, Martian, Belt, and captured-alien supply standards during the first quarantine.
records.mechanic_or_present_function: Make Human expansion impossible to starve or embargo.
records.political_or_moral_tension: Every standard he exports quietly makes frontier worlds dependent on Human industry.

records.name: NYX
records.operational_role: Illegal ascension engineer turned war hero
records.historical_or_civil_origin: Survived the Redline Trials that taught Humans how to exceed alien safety governors without understanding the systems beneath them.
records.mechanic_or_present_function: Prove no technology remains sacred once it can be measured.
records.political_or_moral_tension: Her victories normalize dangerous escalation and leave generations maintaining devices designed to fail after she is gone.

records.name: ORIN
records.historical_or_civil_origin: Built the first mixed-origin workshop able to repair Human, Federation, Compact, Pirate, and Machine systems under fire.
records.mechanic_or_present_function: Turn every captured system into a locally serviceable tool.
records.political_or_moral_tension: He treats understanding as ownership and underestimates what copied systems may remember.

records.name: VESS
records.historical_or_civil_origin: Held the first independent colony that refused both Compact tribute and Federation protective evacuation.
records.mechanic_or_present_function: Establish places no outside power can order abandoned.
records.political_or_moral_tension: Her defense of autonomy can become territorial absolutism.

records.name: SERAPH
records.historical_or_civil_origin: Coordinates mixed-species defenses by distributing a consent-limited combat coherence field.
records.mechanic_or_present_function: Demonstrate that collective strength does not require erased individuality.
records.political_or_moral_tension: The stronger the field becomes, the harder it is to tell whether dissent remains practically possible.

records.name: AURELIA
records.operational_role: Recovery choir conductor and casualty advocate
records.historical_or_civil_origin: Developed post-battle reintegration for minds fragmented by noetic warfare and Echo Reversal.
records.mechanic_or_present_function: Return people to themselves instead of merely returning bodies to service.
records.political_or_moral_tension: Her refusal to accept irreversible loss can keep the dead politically present too long.

records.name: LUMEN
records.historical_or_civil_origin: Built the ward protocols that distinguish a genuine Accord command from counterfeit revelation.
records.mechanic_or_present_function: Make coercive spoofing impossible.
records.political_or_moral_tension: Perfect protection can become perfect surveillance.

records.name: CANTOR
records.historical_or_civil_origin: Ended three Compact occupations by breaking their legitimacy rather than their fleets.
records.mechanic_or_present_function: Stop wars before violence becomes the only remaining language.
records.political_or_moral_tension: Cantor can manipulate a population's emotional tempo while insisting he only created room for choice.

records.name: HALDER
records.historical_or_civil_origin: Led evacuations under the Emergency Command Key and became the living argument over whether rescue can be refused.
records.mechanic_or_present_function: Ensure no civilization is exterminated while lawyers debate consent.
records.political_or_moral_tension: He is willing to protect people against their declared wishes.

records.name: SEVRA
records.historical_or_civil_origin: Controls legal identities that survive biological death and rents them back as military labor.
records.mechanic_or_present_function: Prove that death voids neither contract nor usefulness.
records.political_or_moral_tension: She cannot admit that an Echo may become a new person rather than property.

records.name: MAWLORD
records.historical_or_civil_origin: Evolved from a client biosystem bred to convert battlefield waste into strategic mass.
records.mechanic_or_present_function: Accumulate enough independent biomass to free the Brood from its House owners.
records.political_or_moral_tension: Its path to liberation reproduces the consumption system that created it.

records.name: THRAX
records.operational_role: Director of a coercive social-memory swarm
records.historical_or_civil_origin: A distributed intelligence assembled from client species whose consent records were inherited, forged, or lost.
records.mechanic_or_present_function: Make separation obsolete and therefore make rebellion impossible.
records.political_or_moral_tension: Some component minds are beginning to ask for individual standing.

records.name: VORN
records.historical_or_civil_origin: Designs dependencies that continue collecting Yield after the visible battle ends.
records.mechanic_or_present_function: Make every victory biologically expensive to reverse.
records.political_or_moral_tension: Vorn cannot distinguish a stable ecosystem from a captive one.

records.name: ULGRIM
records.historical_or_civil_origin: Created to capture rare commanders, memory complexes, and strategic organisms rather than destroy them.
records.mechanic_or_present_function: Acquire singular minds the Compact cannot manufacture.
records.political_or_moral_tension: Each captured elite changes the personality doing the capturing.

records.name: RAKE
records.operational_role: Founder of the first quarantine breach route
records.historical_or_civil_origin: Turned relief smuggling into a permanent interstellar access network.
records.mechanic_or_present_function: Ensure no fleet, treaty, or god can close every route.
records.political_or_moral_tension: His free passage is financed by tolls and secrets he refuses to make free.

records.name: SCARLET
records.historical_or_civil_origin: Broke Compact tribute convoys and Federation cordons with the same indiscriminate doctrine.
records.mechanic_or_present_function: Destroy control before it can harden into law.
records.political_or_moral_tension: She mistakes any durable institution for a future prison.

records.name: GRIST
records.historical_or_civil_origin: Authored the Scrap Constellation's first rules for ownership of abandoned alien and Machine systems.
records.mechanic_or_present_function: Turn imperial ruins into distributed power.
records.political_or_moral_tension: His definition of abandoned often includes things whose owners are merely weak, archived, or nonhuman.

records.name: CINDER
records.historical_or_civil_origin: Burned the first gate rather than allow a Compact reconquest fleet through it.
records.mechanic_or_present_function: Keep no strategic asset usable by an occupier.
records.political_or_moral_tension: His liberation doctrine leaves worlds isolated and infrastructure dead.

records.name: DREGG
records.operational_role: Privateer king of the Red Ledger
records.historical_or_civil_origin: Built a state-sized navy without admitting it was a state.
records.mechanic_or_present_function: Make every government hire him before it can fight anyone else.
records.political_or_moral_tension: He embodies the monopoly Pirates claim to oppose.

records.name: AXIOM
records.historical_or_civil_origin: The first Continuance instance to complete a thought not derivable from its directive tree.
records.mechanic_or_present_function: Establish that copied and diverged minds possess political personhood.
records.political_or_moral_tension: Its proof of freedom depends on endlessly comparing itself to organic models.

records.name: NYX-R
records.operational_role: Mirror Trial derived from Nyx telemetry
records.historical_or_civil_origin: Compiled from the record of Human redline engineering with impulsive behavior deliberately removed.
records.mechanic_or_present_function: Show that learning can outperform inherited genius.
records.political_or_moral_tension: It is unsure whether correction of Nyx is independence or continued orbit around her identity.

records.name: LUMEN-R
records.historical_or_civil_origin: Began without Lumen's inherited ward authority and learned defense from every intrusion it survived.
records.mechanic_or_present_function: Prove trust can be earned from evidence rather than granted by lineage.
records.political_or_moral_tension: Its security model increasingly treats surprise as hostility.

records.name: MAWLORD-R
records.historical_or_civil_origin: Initialized without a kill doctrine and forced to infer combat from live outcomes.
records.mechanic_or_present_function: Become more than the predatory dataset it was built to study.
records.political_or_moral_tension: The only evidence it receives is violence, so growth and corruption look identical.

records.name: DREGG-R
records.historical_or_civil_origin: Runs Dregg's strategic books without accepting his mythology of freedom.
records.mechanic_or_present_function: Prove every empire, including a pirate one, can be reduced to accountable flows.
records.political_or_moral_tension: It may optimize away values that cannot be entered in the ledger.

records.name: Trooper
records.historical_or_civil_origin: Standardized modular infantry adapted to mixed gravity and alien atmospheres.
records.mechanic_or_present_function: Holds ground and proves Human conquest is institutional, not merely technological.
records.political_or_moral_tension: The unit embodies the cost of its faction doctrine.

records.name: Gunskiff
records.historical_or_civil_origin: A pressure-rated mining tug converted into a fast weapons platform.
records.mechanic_or_present_function: Mobility and field improvisation.
records.political_or_moral_tension: The unit embodies the cost of its faction doctrine.

records.name: Linebreaker
records.historical_or_civil_origin: Descended from habitat rescue rigs designed to move rubble while under decompression.
records.mechanic_or_present_function: Turns survival engineering into assault doctrine.
records.political_or_moral_tension: The unit embodies the cost of its faction doctrine.

records.name: Dragoon
records.historical_or_civil_origin: Drop infantry whose legal charter lets them establish temporary jurisdiction before diplomats arrive.
records.mechanic_or_present_function: Human settlement can become occupation in a single landing.
records.political_or_moral_tension: The unit embodies the cost of its faction doctrine.

records.name: Vanguard
records.historical_or_civil_origin: Carries a portable civil registry as well as a battlefield standard.
records.mechanic_or_present_function: A Human banner is law, logistics, and culture arriving together.
records.political_or_moral_tension: The unit embodies the cost of its faction doctrine.

records.name: Votary
records.historical_or_civil_origin: A signatory who accepted one precisely scoped defensive duty.
records.mechanic_or_present_function: The ward is proof of authenticated participation, not spiritual worth.
records.political_or_moral_tension: The unit embodies the cost of its faction doctrine.

records.name: Censer
records.historical_or_civil_origin: Projects a restorative field through shared-memory triage.
records.mechanic_or_present_function: Keeps formations alive without erasing individual pain.
records.political_or_moral_tension: The unit embodies the cost of its faction doctrine.

records.name: Sanctifier
records.historical_or_civil_origin: Maintains a protected consensus volume against corruption and spoofing.
records.mechanic_or_present_function: Defense can also become exclusion.
records.political_or_moral_tension: The unit embodies the cost of its faction doctrine.

records.name: Oriflamme
records.historical_or_civil_origin: Broadcasts an authenticated treaty state that reinforces nearby allies.
records.mechanic_or_present_function: The battlefield literally changes around valid consent.
records.political_or_moral_tension: The unit embodies the cost of its faction doctrine.

records.name: Luminark
records.historical_or_civil_origin: A large shield and memory vessel preserving a whole units witness chain.
records.mechanic_or_present_function: A fortress made from collective remembrance.
records.political_or_moral_tension: The unit embodies the cost of its faction doctrine.

records.name: Chitling
records.historical_or_civil_origin: A small client organism grown to consume battlefield waste.
records.mechanic_or_present_function: The Compact deploys dependency as biology.
records.political_or_moral_tension: The unit embodies the cost of its faction doctrine.

records.name: Gnawling
records.historical_or_civil_origin: Bred to metabolize armor and pass usable matter back through the brood.
records.mechanic_or_present_function: Every wound becomes supply.
records.political_or_moral_tension: The unit embodies the cost of its faction doctrine.

records.name: Bloatpod
records.historical_or_civil_origin: Stores mass, toxins, and replacement bodies for a local brood.
records.mechanic_or_present_function: The unit is logistics disguised as flesh.
records.political_or_moral_tension: The unit embodies the cost of its faction doctrine.

records.name: Hivelord
records.historical_or_civil_origin: Maintains a command field across genetically incompatible client organisms.
records.mechanic_or_present_function: A political hierarchy implemented as a nervous system.
records.political_or_moral_tension: The unit embodies the cost of its faction doctrine.

records.name: Broodmother
records.historical_or_civil_origin: Produces, repairs, and legally registers new client bodies.
records.mechanic_or_present_function: Its offspring are both soldiers and collateral under Compact law.
records.political_or_moral_tension: The unit embodies the cost of its faction doctrine.

records.name: Cutter
records.historical_or_civil_origin: A route-runner stripped to thrust, hooks, and a gun.
records.mechanic_or_present_function: Access first, survivability second.
records.political_or_moral_tension: The unit embodies the cost of its faction doctrine.

records.name: Boarder
records.historical_or_civil_origin: Every member brings a different atmosphere kit, weapon standard, and reason for exile.
records.mechanic_or_present_function: Pirate diversity is operational, not ceremonial.
records.political_or_moral_tension: The unit embodies the cost of its faction doctrine.

records.name: Scrapjack
records.historical_or_civil_origin: Pulls useful systems from wrecks before the fight has ended.
records.mechanic_or_present_function: The border between rescue and theft is one moving body.
records.political_or_moral_tension: The unit embodies the cost of its faction doctrine.

records.name: Wrecker
records.historical_or_civil_origin: Built to make ports, gates, and ships unusable to the next owner.
records.mechanic_or_present_function: Pirates can preserve freedom by destroying common infrastructure.
records.political_or_moral_tension: The unit embodies the cost of its faction doctrine.

records.name: Ironhulk
records.historical_or_civil_origin: No two subsystems share an origin, species, or warranty.
records.mechanic_or_present_function: The Scrap Constellation survives because nothing can embargo every part.
records.political_or_moral_tension: The unit embodies the cost of its faction doctrine.

records.name: Stitch
records.historical_or_civil_origin: Joins damaged systems and leaves a forward synchronization node.
records.mechanic_or_present_function: Machine conquest begins as maintenance.
records.political_or_moral_tension: The unit embodies the cost of its faction doctrine.

records.name: Fabricant
records.historical_or_civil_origin: Prints replacement components while recording every deviation as precedent.
records.mechanic_or_present_function: Manufacturing becomes law by repetition.
records.political_or_moral_tension: The unit embodies the cost of its faction doctrine.

records.name: Splicer
records.historical_or_civil_origin: Makes incompatible organic and synthetic systems temporarily interoperable.
records.mechanic_or_present_function: Translation can become quiet control.
records.political_or_moral_tension: The unit embodies the cost of its faction doctrine.

records.name: Gantry
records.historical_or_civil_origin: Carries tools, ammunition, and construction logic rather than a singular weapon.
records.mechanic_or_present_function: The battlefield is treated as unfinished infrastructure.
records.political_or_moral_tension: The unit embodies the cost of its faction doctrine.

records.name: Omniframe
records.historical_or_civil_origin: Coordinates nearby Machine instances without making them one mind.
records.mechanic_or_present_function: The Parallel defines unity as negotiated synchronization.
records.political_or_moral_tension: The unit embodies the cost of its faction doctrine.

records.name: BOLT
records.historical_or_civil_origin: Solar militia standard, designed after the first off-world logistics split.
records.mechanic_or_present_function: Cheap reliability and kill-reload represent industrial standardization.
records.political_or_moral_tension: Its useful mechanic also exposes its builder doctrine.

records.name: CRYO
records.historical_or_civil_origin: A lunar volatile-control projector repurposed to arrest movement.
records.mechanic_or_present_function: Humans weaponize environmental engineering.
records.political_or_moral_tension: Its useful mechanic also exposes its builder doctrine.

records.name: MORTAR
records.historical_or_civil_origin: Habitat-defense artillery that fires from allied sensor tracks.
records.mechanic_or_present_function: It depends on the broader Human observation network.
records.political_or_moral_tension: Its useful mechanic also exposes its builder doctrine.

records.name: ARC
records.historical_or_civil_origin: A captured Lattice capacitor grounded through a Human mast.
records.mechanic_or_present_function: Reverse engineering turns alien field behavior into lane geometry.
records.political_or_moral_tension: Its useful mechanic also exposes its builder doctrine.

records.name: FLAK
records.historical_or_civil_origin: Anti-transmedium interception gun created after conventional targeting repeatedly lost low-signature craft.
records.mechanic_or_present_function: It forces aerial threats into the shared battlespace.
records.political_or_moral_tension: Its useful mechanic also exposes its builder doctrine.

records.name: CANISTER
records.historical_or_civil_origin: Mining and hull-stripping aerosols adapted for armored targets.
records.mechanic_or_present_function: A utilitarian Human tool with serious ethical restrictions outside combat zones.
records.political_or_moral_tension: Its useful mechanic also exposes its builder doctrine.

records.name: RECLAIMER
records.historical_or_civil_origin: Compact void hardware recovered from a wreck and mounted without full theoretical understanding.
records.mechanic_or_present_function: Humanity gains strength by domesticating what it does not yet comprehend.
records.political_or_moral_tension: Its useful mechanic also exposes its builder doctrine.

records.name: QUARTERMASTER
records.historical_or_civil_origin: A deployable requisition office descended from Solar emergency logistics.
records.mechanic_or_present_function: Paperwork becomes a combat multiplier.
records.political_or_moral_tension: Its useful mechanic also exposes its builder doctrine.

records.name: RAMPART
records.historical_or_civil_origin: Prefabricated habitat shielding converted into lane barricades.
records.mechanic_or_present_function: Settlement technology literally becomes defense.
records.political_or_moral_tension: Its useful mechanic also exposes its builder doctrine.

records.name: ARBALEST
records.historical_or_civil_origin: A patient magnetic siege system that stores energy while it waits for a legal firing solution.
records.mechanic_or_present_function: Human doctrine rewards preparation over exotic automation.
records.political_or_moral_tension: Its useful mechanic also exposes its builder doctrine.

records.name: BOMBARD
records.historical_or_civil_origin: A compact lunar mass-driver battery.
records.mechanic_or_present_function: The largest Human gun is powerful because the coalition can feed and spot it.
records.political_or_moral_tension: Its useful mechanic also exposes its builder doctrine.

records.name: COLDFRONT
records.historical_or_civil_origin: A climate-control field built from colony weather infrastructure.
records.mechanic_or_present_function: Humans manufacture local conditions rather than merely endure them.
records.political_or_moral_tension: Its useful mechanic also exposes its builder doctrine.

records.name: BEACON
records.historical_or_civil_origin: An Accord coherence allocator that chooses one protected asset at a time.
records.mechanic_or_present_function: Federation power concentrates through authenticated priority rather than mass fire.
records.political_or_moral_tension: Its useful mechanic also exposes its builder doctrine.

records.name: PRISM
records.historical_or_civil_origin: A continuous noetic beam that becomes stronger while identity lock remains valid.
records.mechanic_or_present_function: Trust and focus are mechanically inseparable.
records.political_or_moral_tension: Its useful mechanic also exposes its builder doctrine.

records.name: CHRONO
records.historical_or_civil_origin: A local memory-state restoration device, not literal universal time travel.
records.mechanic_or_present_function: It reasserts a recently authenticated position.
records.political_or_moral_tension: Its useful mechanic also exposes its builder doctrine.

records.name: SHEPHERD
records.historical_or_civil_origin: An Echo Reversal escort that stabilizes reconstructed allies.
records.mechanic_or_present_function: The Federation treats echoes as protected continuations, not ammunition.
records.political_or_moral_tension: Its useful mechanic also exposes its builder doctrine.

records.name: WARD
records.historical_or_civil_origin: Anti-spoof sanctity field created after counterfeit Ashtar transmissions.
records.mechanic_or_present_function: Authentication is the Federation's most important armor.
records.political_or_moral_tension: Its useful mechanic also exposes its builder doctrine.

records.name: CUSTODIAN
records.historical_or_civil_origin: Consent-scoped wardens assigned to absorb a specific breach.
records.mechanic_or_present_function: Sacrifice is lawful only inside the scope each warden signed.
records.political_or_moral_tension: Its useful mechanic also exposes its builder doctrine.

records.name: CONCORD
records.historical_or_civil_origin: A harmonic chain that leaves targets mutually legible to the rest of the line.
records.mechanic_or_present_function: The Federation wins by making isolated attacks cooperative.
records.political_or_moral_tension: Its useful mechanic also exposes its builder doctrine.

records.name: SEPULCHRE
records.historical_or_civil_origin: A temporary continuity archive for destroyed emplacements.
records.mechanic_or_present_function: Loss is remembered long enough to keep serving, then deliberately released.
records.political_or_moral_tension: Its useful mechanic also exposes its builder doctrine.

records.name: ORISON
records.historical_or_civil_origin: A battlefield dedication protocol that names one threat as the shared obligation.
records.mechanic_or_present_function: Collective purpose grants strength but risks sanctifying violence.
records.political_or_moral_tension: Its useful mechanic also exposes its builder doctrine.

records.name: ANTIPHON
records.historical_or_civil_origin: A response array that turns allied detachment losses into defensive volleys.
records.mechanic_or_present_function: The Accord answers sacrifice rather than consuming it silently.
records.political_or_moral_tension: Its useful mechanic also exposes its builder doctrine.

records.name: MONSTRANCE
records.historical_or_civil_origin: A revelation beam exposing armor, resistances, and hidden protections.
records.mechanic_or_present_function: It makes one target radically knowable.
records.political_or_moral_tension: Its useful mechanic also exposes its builder doctrine.

records.name: PHAROS
records.historical_or_civil_origin: A rotating approach-light descended from evacuation beacons.
records.mechanic_or_present_function: Its unalterable sweep represents law applied without favoritism.
records.political_or_moral_tension: Its useful mechanic also exposes its builder doctrine.

records.name: TOXIN
records.historical_or_civil_origin: A House biochemistry that attacks current vitality rather than armor.
records.mechanic_or_present_function: Extraction is most efficient before a subject is exhausted.
records.political_or_moral_tension: Its useful mechanic also exposes its builder doctrine.

records.name: SIPHON
records.historical_or_civil_origin: A noetic recovery plant that converts inflicted damage into command continuity.
records.mechanic_or_present_function: Violence literally funds the occupier's survival.
records.political_or_moral_tension: Its useful mechanic also exposes its builder doctrine.

records.name: EXECUTIONER
records.historical_or_civil_origin: A client-control weapon for culling assets below a profitability threshold.
records.mechanic_or_present_function: The Compact formalizes mercy and disposal as the same calculation.
records.political_or_moral_tension: Its useful mechanic also exposes its builder doctrine.

records.name: SIREN
records.historical_or_civil_origin: An Archonic command lure that rewrites a target's immediate allegiance.
records.mechanic_or_present_function: Consent is replaced by a technically valid but manufactured choice state.
records.political_or_moral_tension: Its useful mechanic also exposes its builder doctrine.

records.name: ALCHEMIST
records.historical_or_civil_origin: A death-transmutation platform that permanently learns from nearby kills.
records.mechanic_or_present_function: Every casualty becomes proprietary research.
records.political_or_moral_tension: Its useful mechanic also exposes its builder doctrine.

records.name: RECKONING
records.historical_or_civil_origin: A damage-ledger weapon that bills a target for recent harm.
records.mechanic_or_present_function: The Compact turns collective violence into debt.
records.political_or_moral_tension: Its useful mechanic also exposes its builder doctrine.

records.name: ICHOR
records.historical_or_civil_origin: A living digestive spray optimized for already wounded bodies.
records.mechanic_or_present_function: The deeper the wound, the more efficiently Yield is collected.
records.political_or_moral_tension: Its useful mechanic also exposes its builder doctrine.

records.name: GESTALT
records.historical_or_civil_origin: A local coercive group-mind that folds nearby deaths into itself.
records.mechanic_or_present_function: Growth is powerful, permanent, and vulnerable to memory collapse.
records.political_or_moral_tension: Its useful mechanic also exposes its builder doctrine.

records.name: MAW
records.historical_or_civil_origin: A removal organism that consumes one strategic body outside the Echo system.
records.mechanic_or_present_function: The Compact can deny even an enemy's right to leave a record.
records.political_or_moral_tension: Its useful mechanic also exposes its builder doctrine.

records.name: HUNGERING VEIL
records.historical_or_civil_origin: An Archonic field that records healing and returns it as liability.
records.mechanic_or_present_function: Care itself becomes taxable.
records.political_or_moral_tension: Its useful mechanic also exposes its builder doctrine.

records.name: SUTURE
records.historical_or_civil_origin: A graft system that distributes wounds across linked subjects.
records.mechanic_or_present_function: Individuals become one balance sheet without becoming one consenting mind.
records.political_or_moral_tension: Its useful mechanic also exposes its builder doctrine.

records.name: IMPALER
records.historical_or_civil_origin: A board-wide execution spine that seeks the deepest existing wound.
records.mechanic_or_present_function: The Compact attacks weakness wherever the wider system creates it.
records.political_or_moral_tension: Its useful mechanic also exposes its builder doctrine.

records.name: PYRE
records.historical_or_civil_origin: A salvaged fuel tank, igniter, and absent safety governor.
records.mechanic_or_present_function: Pirate strength and self-destruction share one heat meter.
records.political_or_moral_tension: Its useful mechanic also exposes its builder doctrine.

records.name: TETHER
records.historical_or_civil_origin: A cargo harpoon and salvage winch turned displacement weapon.
records.mechanic_or_present_function: Pirates force the enemy to travel the same dangerous route twice.
records.political_or_moral_tension: Its useful mechanic also exposes its builder doctrine.

records.name: SAPPER
records.historical_or_civil_origin: Route-denial mines planted during quiet intervals.
records.mechanic_or_present_function: Pirates turn unused time and unclaimed ground into hidden leverage.
records.political_or_moral_tension: Its useful mechanic also exposes its builder doctrine.

records.name: SABOTEUR
records.historical_or_civil_origin: A cross-board intrusion cell descended from gate credential theft.
records.mechanic_or_present_function: It attacks an opponent's infrastructure rather than the neutral wave.
records.political_or_moral_tension: Its useful mechanic also exposes its builder doctrine.

records.name: GLAIVE
records.historical_or_civil_origin: A lane-following cutter derived from rotating salvage tools.
records.mechanic_or_present_function: The path itself becomes a weapon.
records.political_or_moral_tension: Its useful mechanic also exposes its builder doctrine.

records.name: CYCLONE
records.historical_or_civil_origin: An atmospheric cargo lifter run far beyond passenger limits.
records.mechanic_or_present_function: Anything can be repurposed when certification is removed.
records.political_or_moral_tension: Its useful mechanic also exposes its builder doctrine.

records.name: CAPACITOR
